seo.title: Steps AI vs AiSensy: an honest comparison | Steps AI
seo.description: Compare Steps AI and AiSensy: channels, order lookups, pricing model and where each one is the better fit.

hero.title: Steps AI vs AiSensy: marketing sends or full conversations.
hero.body: AiSensy is a WhatsApp marketing platform that many Indian brands use for broadcasts and campaigns. Steps AI sends WhatsApp campaigns as well, and its agent answers the replies, checks orders and books appointments across every channel.
hero.reassurance: Where we fit. Where they fit. How to switch.

glance.title: At a glance.
glance.intro: How Steps AI and AiSensy compare on the questions owners ask most.

rows.label: What it is
rows.steps: An AI agent that answers customers and checks real records before it replies
rows.them: A WhatsApp marketing platform for broadcasts and campaigns

rows.label: Channels
rows.steps: Website, WhatsApp, Instagram and Messenger from one Meta connection, plus phone calls
rows.them: WhatsApp first, with Instagram on some plans

rows.label: Order and delivery questions
rows.steps: Checks orders in Shopify or WooCommerce and shipments with five Indian carriers
rows.them: Through flows and connected apps you set up

rows.label: How you pay
rows.steps: Per reply in credits. The cost of a reply depends on the AI model you choose
rows.them: Monthly plans plus WhatsApp conversation charges

rows.label: What happens after the answer
rows.steps: Books appointments, creates tickets, saves leads and hands over to a person
rows.them: Sends campaigns and runs the chatbot flows you build

ours.title: When Steps AI is the better fit.
ours.intro: Choose Steps AI if these sound like you.

items.title: Replies matter as much as sends
items.body: When a customer answers a campaign, the Steps AI agent picks up the conversation instead of leaving it waiting.

items.title: You need help beyond WhatsApp
items.body: The same agent answers on your website, Instagram and Messenger.

items.title: You want order and delivery answers
items.body: The agent checks Shopify, WooCommerce and five Indian carriers before it replies.

theirs.title: When AiSensy may suit you better.
theirs.intro: We would rather you pick the right tool than the wrong one.

items.title: High-volume campaigns come first
items.body: Steps AI campaigns are currently capped at 1,000 messages per send, which may not suit very large lists.

items.title: You run click-to-WhatsApp ads at scale
items.body: Ad tools are a focus for WhatsApp marketing platforms. Ask us where Steps AI is on ads today.

switching.title: Moving from AiSensy to Steps AI.
switching.intro: Most businesses are answering real customers within a day.

items.title: Paste your website address
items.body: Steps AI reads your pages, FAQs and documents, so you do not have to rebuild your answers by hand.

items.title: Connect your channels and store
items.body: One Meta connection covers WhatsApp, Instagram and Messenger. Add Shopify or WooCommerce for order questions.

items.title: Test it against your own questions
items.body: Ask the questions your customers ask. Switch it on when you are happy with the answers.

goodToKnow.title: Good to know
items: This comparison uses publicly available information about AiSensy as of October 2026. Check their site for current plans and features.
Steps AI does not answer inbound email, and AI voice calls are billed as credits.

faq.title: Questions about Steps AI and AiSensy.

items.q: Can I try Steps AI before I switch?
items.a: Yes. You can start free with no card, test the agent against your own questions and switch when you are ready.
You pay per reply in credits. The number of credits a reply uses depends on the AI model you choose for your agent.

items.q: Can I run Steps AI alongside AiSensy?
items.a: Yes, many businesses test both before deciding. Make sure only one tool replies on each channel at a time.
